summary: Change the layers in dependency order. The schema migration and the alias validation are independent and run in parallel; the repository and service build on both; the API contract comes last. Each task extends the tests of the layer it touches, and the existing suite is the regression net.
test_strategy: Regression first: the existing 65 tests must stay green, with one deliberate edit (three-character codes become valid). New behaviour is tested per layer: the migration against a populated v1 database and against a failing script, alias syntax in the codec, expiry boundaries and alias conflicts in the service with an injected clock, and status codes through the API. The expiry boundary gets a test one microsecond before and exactly at the instant.

tasks.title: Schema migration 2: expiry and custom-code columns
tasks.description: Append an additive migration adding links.expires_at (nullable) and links.is_custom (default 0). Test the upgrade of a populated v1 database and the atomicity of a failing migration.

tasks.title: Alias validation
tasks.description: Add alias syntax and reserved-name validation to the codec and widen the code syntax so aliases are valid codes. Update the one existing test that encoded the old minimum length.

tasks.title: Expiry and aliases in repository and service
tasks.description: Persist and load the new columns; validate lifetimes, reserve aliases atomically through the primary key, and refuse to resolve expired links.

tasks.title: API contract for expiry and aliases
tasks.description: Expose alias and expires_in_seconds on the create request and expires_at and is_custom on responses; map the new domain errors to 409 and 422; bump the version.
